Hello!

I really like the illustrations you make with camisole and shorts. I think they are all really cute so I would like to request a similar art of vtuber 月宮ゆめか. If possible, I would like to leave everything up to you (things like the atmosphere, pose, setting etc).

With her hairstyle, I would like her to have short hair with hairbuns like in this image: https://x.com/Yume_tanMT/status/1807934429954035757

ゆめかさん is a very lively and energetic person with ギャル vibes if this helps with deciding on things like pose, atmosphere and background.

Thank you so much~
